benchmarks.evidence: Matched production HTTP runs against Ruby and Django: identical ordered windows, successful persisted body-bearing writes, FTS and SQLite integrity. Real resized JPEGs verified. Two paced runs admit all 100 sockets and fully deliver all 30 messages; no capacity limit inferred. Raw outputs remain ignored. These figures were measured on the nginx + PHP-FPM runtime and have not been re-measured on FrankenPHP.

worker_mode.evidence: PHPUnit boots one Octane application and drives anonymous, signed-in and second-user requests through it: current-user meta, Rails CSRF secret, rejected cross-session token, message author, personal sidebar stream and shared view data never cross requests; per-request services add no listeners. Production image, worker mode, 16 concurrent clients mixing four users and anonymous visitors: every room page carried its own user and CSRF secret, every sidebar its own signed stream, no login page a user (13.7k requests in 10 seconds, 0 mismatches; also in classic mode and as a non-root user).

response_cache.evidence: Native page and fragment regressions cover hot reuse, current tokens/cookies and literal text, local and foreign SQLite commits, unversioned body/creator/boost changes on conditional, flash, cache-disabled and broadcast paths, session/membership revocation, pre-auth and mid-render admission epochs, origin separation, detached rendering and transaction rollback, including raw SQLite BEGIN with Laravel transaction level zero. Pages and native fragments share one bounded worker cache; no external generation namespaces accumulate. Full native suite: 71 tests, 945 assertions. Fresh final production browser and foreign-write checks pass with a 64 MiB cache and with caching disabled, including body/creator/boost/styles edits, conditional freshness and session/membership revocation. Final source f054cd6 was independently remeasured using the strict shared harness d88b346; all responses and exact acknowledged writes passed. Current figures are in https://github.com/basecamp/once-campfire-verification/blob/main/docs/performance-review.md.

verification.sqlite_synchronous: Both connections now use synchronous=NORMAL in WAL mode, as Rails' SQLite3Adapter::DEFAULT_PRAGMAS do. Before, synchronous=FULL held every write lock across an fsync (4-14 ms per commit on the test volume). SQLite's backing-off busy handler then made a request inserting a job wait up to 1-3 s behind the queue worker's commits; profiled, the jobs insert took 250-1,068 ms, and with the queue worker stopped the waits vanished. Single client posting 300 messages: upstream PHP-FPM image 14 -> 58 posts/s (p99 802 -> 69 ms); FrankenPHP worker mode 14 -> 199 posts/s (p99 1,369 -> 38 ms).
verification.authentication_join: Fresh indexed session/user join on every request, extracted from Jack Ellis PR #2 at 661bd108; preserves pre-auth response-cache epoch capture and current session ID. Warm reads execute one auth join; native regressions cover foreign role/status/session-user changes and revocation, plus commits racing authentication and rendering. No authentication row is cached. Full native suite: 71 tests, 945 assertions.
verification.writer_lock_transaction_end: Jack Ellis PR #2 at 50666d7 retains native writer scheduling through the SQLite connector and PDO. Native regressions verify commit/explicit rollback/automatic rollback/manual transaction/failed BEGIN/nested savepoint/failed statement and deferred foreign-key failed COMMIT lock lifecycles. Writer locks use the framework-resolved canonical database path and respect its configured SQLite busy timeout. Raw BEGIN through statement APIs holds the lock until commit/rollback, bypasses committed response and fragment caches, and is rolled back at the Octane request boundary even when Laravel transaction level is zero. All 71 native tests, 945 assertions and full Pint (76 files) pass; Fresh final production browser and foreign-write checks pass with a 64 MiB cache and with caching disabled, including body/creator/boost/styles edits, conditional freshness and session/membership revocation. Final source f054cd6 was independently remeasured using the strict shared harness d88b346; all responses and exact acknowledged writes passed. Current figures are in https://github.com/basecamp/once-campfire-verification/blob/main/docs/performance-review.md.
verification.laravel_performance_pr: Integrated Jack Ellis PR #2 at 50666d7 with current pre-auth cache epoch/session ID and warmed bounded cache preserved. Native tests cover formatted and entity-encoded sound commands, cookie reuse versus login/logout/return-to changes and a valid CSRF post, guest-cookie retirement and warm-session revocation, plus foreign mentioned-user/blob edits across actual Octane requests. Source read of the pinned queue worker confirms job scopes reset between daemon iterations. Rejected raw-HTML sound shortcut and corrected failed-COMMIT lock release; final native, production browser and matched performance checks passed; advertised branch throughput is not assumed. Exact payload comparison also reissues cookies for distinct numeric string return targets.
